negative_snippets:
⭐ 1/5 — Worst Hotel Experience. Completely Unprofessional & Mismanaged.

I stayed at Dusky Hotel & Restaurant during my exam at M.A. Global Examination Centre, Sector 22 Rohini, and the stay was honestly pathetic from start to finish.

❌ Scam in Pricing

When I reached, the board clearly said “Rooms @ ₹600”, but on call, the owner told me the room was ₹1500.
After reaching, I found out rooms were actually available for ₹1200 and even less.
It genuinely felt like they took advantage because I travelled all the way from Punjab and urgently needed a room.

The receptionist made excuses that cheaper rooms were “booked”, but only 2 rooms were actually occupied.

❌ Dirty Room & Terrible Washroom

The room looked fine from outside, but:
•	Washroom was extremely dirty
•	Commode was broken
•	Washroom lock was jammed
•	Sink had hair
•	Bedsheet had holes
•	The room was not cleaned after previous use
•	Only one old towel provided
•	No soap, no shampoo, no water—not even basic amenities
•	A glass was kept which was full of dirt

I asked them to clean the sink; they barely removed the visible hair. That’s it.

❌ Unprofessional Behaviour

Later the owner called and instead of listening, he:
•	Accused us of “troubling” the staff
•	Said he would believe his employee over me
•	Told me to “go stay at Radisson” if I wasn’t satisfied
•	Argued even after I said the room wasn’t clean

I had already paid ₹500 online, and he acted like refunding was doing me a favour.

❌ Morning Comment From Owner

In the morning, while I was checking out, the owner said to me:
“You studied in a different room, I didn’t say anything… you used two rooms.”

I had only sat in another room for barely 1–2 hours because the chair in my room was broken and leaned all the way back, making it impossible to study. He still counted that as “using two rooms”.

❌ Zero Knowledge & No Basic Supplies

There was not even handwash in the bathroom.
When I asked, the receptionist gave us a fabric perfume mixed with water as “handwash”.
My father immediately pointed out that it didn’t even lather. This shows their lack of basic knowledge and hygiene.

❌ Mosquitoes, Smell & Poor Location
•	The room was filled with mosquitoes; me and my father barely slept.
•	The tap water smelt like sewage—we had to buy water bottles to brush.
•	The location is extremely poor and unsafe.
•	A big dirty water pond is right in front of the hotel.
•	The area is underdeveloped, and even delivery guys struggle to find it.
•	No market nearby at all.

❌ Overall

Except for the four walls, everything else was below basic standards.
This was a “no choice” situation because of my exam, or I would never have stayed here.

👉 I strongly do NOT recommend this hotel to anyone.
There are better and safer stays on the other side of the area with proper markets and better access.

Never staying here again.
Forgot to click pictures of the room and the washroom.
I would say owner was good only if he had addressed the issue as an issue and not as a trouble.
